content: The instances for docs#Language abuse the defeq between Language α and Set (List α) a lot. This caused trouble recently in cslib's nightly-testing branch where a lot of grinds started failing. I propose we add Language.ofSet and Language.toSet and use those to define the instances in a way that doesn't abuse defeqs. An alternative approach might be to make Language a one-field structure; but that would probably require more work since we don't have the automation to do this nicely. Any thoughts?
It looks like the one-field structure approach is in progress at #36934? cc: @Jeremy Tan
Jeremy is close to redefining Language alpha as an abbrev for SetSemiring (FreeMonoid alpha). This seems optimal to me (modulo adding toSet/ofSet for convenience)
I will need #37733 as well for this redefinition
